instagram.author: tiffanymartinx
instagram.body:
My emotional support app🥰

#app #august #doctor #healthcare #augustapp
Okay, so my doctor's appointment wasn't for another 10 days, and apparently no one talks about how stressful the waiting process is. Should I wait? Should I call? Am I overreacting, etc.? And every day, you convince yourself of something different. So I decided to put everything into August. Not because I wanted a diagnosis, just that I wanted to know what step I should take next, and just have some help understanding everything that's going on. And honestly, having that clarity made the waiting process so much easier. I swear the worst part about health issues is the uncertainty, so that's where August just really, really like put me at ease and saved me a days of overthinking. Like I owe it all to August, I really do.

tiktok.author: keepbufoalive
tiktok.body:
Replying to @Just Jen why aren’t we in the App Store?
Ponder Club will never have an app, and the three reasons why are? One, it's too much work, I'm the only developer, and having to maintain web, uh, Android, and I O s would be way too hard. 2. They take quite a big chunk of every transaction, and, you know, we don't have that many transactions to begin with, so taking, you know, 10 to 30% per each transaction would suck for us. And lastly, I really have always loved the flexibility of web. People can play anywhere, and I'm really tired of sites that are just websites taking you to the App Store. I like the freedom and flexibility that a web app has, and I love that our players have access to that. The one thing that does suck about us not being in the App Store or the Play Store is that it can be hard for people to find us because it is kinda confusing. Most people assume we would be in the App Store, and when they don't find us, they assume that it's not available in their country. So that's just the one thing that sucks about it. It does make people does make it harder for people to find us, but I think that's worth the trade off.

tiktok.author: otterlist
tiktok.body: One of the most common questions I get is: “Why isn’t there an app yet?” The short answer is that we’re focused on building the platform itself first, and we want to be sustainable before taking that on. The good news is that almost everything an app would do can already be done by adding OtterList to your home screen, giving you quick access with just one tap. An app is definitely part of the long-term vision, but right now we’re focused on adding more brands, more products, and improving the experience for everyone.
